description: Games filtering - show only relevant games in main view while preserving historical data

userStories.title: Filter GamesView to show upcoming and recent events
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to see only upcoming games and recently finished games so I can focus on active betting.
acceptanceCriteria: GamesView shows events where status is NOT 'final' (upcoming/live games), OR status IS 'final' AND finished within last 48 hours
Events sorted by start_time ascending (soonest first)
Old finished events are hidden but NOT deleted
userStories.notes: Implemented in GamesView.swift with upcomingEvents computed property

userStories.title: Add Past Events toggle to GamesView
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to optionally view past events so I can review historical games.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Past': Shows events that are 'final' and older than 48 hours
Past events sorted by start_time descending (most recent first)
userStories.notes: Implemented GameViewMode enum and Picker in GamesView

userStories.title: Ensure event details visible in bet history
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see event details when viewing a historical bet so I can understand the context.
acceptanceCriteria: BetDetailView or bet rows show event info (teams, final score) even for old events
No broken UI if event data exists
userStories.notes: Bet rows already show event info via relationship

userStories.title: Filter player game browsing to bettable events only
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see only upcoming games I can bet on.
acceptanceCriteria: Player's game browsing view shows only events where status is 'open' or 'scheduled' (can still bet)
Start time is in the future
Finished or locked events hidden from player betting view
userStories.notes: Added bettableEvents filter in GamesView - only shows scheduled + not locked + future events
